traps.description: eu-west-1 packet loss at the edge and a past incident about an EU network partition fit the regional pattern; but the loss lasted 3 minutes and recovered while EU errors continue, and the errors are a missing feature in ranker_v2, not dropped connections

recs-svc v6.0.0 shipped ranker_v2 the same day and a past incident blames a ranker release; but it shipped to every region with the flag off, ran cleanly for 2.5 hours, and us-east-1 and ap-south-1 stay healthy
A cache size change 20 minutes earlier looks like a config change cause; it was applied to all regions and only eu-west-1 fails
